title: Late Coffee vs Sleep Score Drop
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:caffeine
| search next_sleep_score_delta=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(next_sleep_score_delta) as avg_next_sleep_score_delta by _time late_caffeine
| sort - _time
description: Tracks sleep-score drop after late coffee over time and breaks it out by late-caffeine flag.
value: Linking late coffee to next-sleep score makes the tradeoff concrete instead of theoretical.
implementation: Send sleep-score drop after late coffee events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of sleep-score drop after late coffee by late-caffeine flag.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds how sleep-score drop after late coffee changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
